subject: Customer request: scoped log retention exception & forensics evidence workflow
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary variance to log deletion window / evidence transfer

Hi Jordan —

We ran into a compliance requirement from our legal team: we need a short-term retention variance for tenant GF-104 so their security team can complete an investigation and forensics. Our standard agreement references a 30-day debug trace TTL, but we need a scoped 90-day hold for this tenant (ID GF-104).

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can create a tenant-scoped snapshot and extend the retention to 90 days for GF-104?
- What evidence artifacts you can provide to demonstrate preservation and eventual deletion (e.g., export, proof-of-delete, hash manifests)?
- The formal request/workflow we should follow so this is auditable for our SOC 2 and SIG review?

I've attached a legal hold notice from our side. We're looking to get the preservation in place this week if possible.

Thanks,
Sara Kim
Head of Security Operations
Greenfield Health
(Attachment: greenfield_legal_hold_notice.pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary variance to log deletion window / evidence transfer

Sara — thanks for the clear note and the legal hold. We can support a scoped, tenant-level preservation for GF-104 but we need to follow our internal exception process to make it auditable. High-level next steps I propose: 

1) You submit a signed retention-exception form (I attached ours).
2) Security (Kimberly) will validate requested artifacts and scope.
3) Eng ops (Ben) will schedule a read-only forensic snapshot and export plan.
4) We provide a time-stamped evidence package (export, hashes, export manifest) and a deletion certificate when the hold ends.

Can you confirm the exact tenant IDs and the start/end dates you want preserved? Also let us know whether this is a rolling 90 days from today or a fixed window. We aim to have the snapshot created within 48 business hours after intake is complete.

I've attached our retention-exception intake form to speed things up.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-retention-exception-form.pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary variance to log deletion window / evidence transfer

Jordan / Ben / Sara — quick security checklist for this type of SOC 2 / SIG-oriented preservation: 

Required artifacts we can produce once scope is confirmed:
- Tenant-scoped export (NDJSON) of retained traces and audit logs with timestamped filenames.
- SHA256 manifest file for each exported object and a signed manifest summary.
- Forensic snapshot metadata (snapshot ID, creation time, storage location, access logs).
- Proof-of-delete certificate (time-stamped, signed by Redwood ops) when the retention window ends.
- Redacted access audit for who accessed the snapshot during the hold.

We can also provide instructions to your auditors for validating the manifest. If Greenfield needs CAIQ or SIG mapping for the artifacts, we have a checklist and export guidance — attaching.

One note: if the request includes retained PII within debug traces, we will only provide exports via our secure evidence channel (SFTP or secure Drive) and require a data transfer agreement addendum.

Proposed timeline after intake completed: snapshot created within 48 hours, export + manifest within 72 hours.

Attaching our SIG/SOC2 evidence checklist and a short SOC2 export guide.

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: sig-evidence-checklist.xlsx, soc2-export-instructions.txt)

> Sara — thanks for the clear note and the legal hold. We can support a scoped, tenant-level preservation for GF-104 but we need to follow our internal exception process to make it auditable. ...

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenfieldhealth.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary variance to log deletion window / evidence transfer

Jordan / Kimberly / Ben —

Thanks all. Confirming details:
- Tenant: GF-104 (all tenant resource IDs attached in the legal hold)
- Window: Fixed hold from 2026-09-04 to 2026-12-03 (90 days)
- Purpose: internal investigation + auditor validation for an in-flight procurement audit
- Export sensitivity: traces may contain small amounts of PII; Greenfield will accept redaction guidance and we will sign the DTA addendum you reference.

We accept the proposed timeline (snapshot within 48 hours after intake). Please schedule a 30-min workshop to walk our auditors through validating the manifest and hashes this week.

Best,
Sara
(Attachment: greenfield_legal_hold_notice.pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: GF-104 retention exception — action items and owner assignment

Kimberly / Ben — internal summary and actions for GF-104 (Greenfield Health):

- Intake: Sara confirmed fixed 90-day hold 2026-09-04 -> 2026-12-03 and signed legal hold. We have the legal_hold.pdf in thread.
- Security: Kimberly to confirm DTA addendum language and produce the evidence checklist deliverables (export, SHA256 manifests, snapshot metadata).
- Eng Ops: Ben to schedule read-only snapshot and export pipeline. Target: snapshot created 2026-09-04 16:00 PT, export+manifest by 2026-09-07 EOD PT.
- Audit / Delivery: Jordan will coordinate secure upload to the Drive folder and schedule a 30-min auditor workshop (proposed: Thu 2026-09-09 09:00 PT).

Ben: please confirm you can provision the snapshot on 9/4 and that exports will be stored in the secure Drive folder (link below).
Kimberly: please confirm if we need additional redaction rules prior to export or whether we can provide guidance for Greenfield to request redaction after export.

Drive upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBexAMPLEsecurefolder
SOC2 report link: https://redwood.example.com/security/SOC2-report-2026

Thanks — once we have Ben/Kim confirmation I'll generate the intake ticket and move to execute.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
